check: SERVING
check a.A: NOT_SERVING
check nope: err rpc error: code = NotFound desc = unknown service
list: ""=SERVING "a.A"=NOT_SERVING
watch b.B: ["SERVICE_UNKNOWN", "SERVING", "NOT_SERVING"]
shutdown: NOT_SERVING NOT_SERVING err rpc error: code = NotFound desc = unknown service
resume: SERVING SERVING SERVING
